title: Golden Mushroom Pilaf
description: A flavorful vegetarian pilaf dish featuring sautéed golden mushrooms and kissed pilaf.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add golden mushrooms and sauté until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add kissed pilaf rice to the skillet and stir to coat with oil and mix with mushrooms.
Pour in Dutch vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
